decisions.reason: A rye country bread fits the firm's core craft range and is cheap to keep in manual production, and there is no sign of a shortfall that would trigger search for other uses of the resources.
The repeated gold medal from the Deutsches Brotinstitut shows the premium raisin stollen exceeds the firm's aspirations, so dropping it is very unlikely.
The seeded rye mixed bread is a low-risk extension of the established bread range, and with no negative evidence the satisficing default is to keep it.
The dark malt rye bread may be a niche item, but it uses existing recipes and ovens and gives no sign of a shortfall, so slack allows carrying it.
Marzipan stollen is a standard seasonal product that matches the firm's holiday and gift business and is likely to meet its aspirations.
The newest ancient grain 'Meisterstück' is promoted actively and fits current demand for traditional and natural grains, so management will give it time despite uncertain results.
